_comment: Byte budgets enforced by scripts/check-release-dist.mjs. Scoped to dist/assets/ (the Vite-built JS/CSS/image graph) — vendored native binaries (hyphon_native*, jc303*, rubberband.wasm), sample .wav files, and the vendored Pyodide runtime (dist/pyodide/) live outside Vite's bundler and are not part of this budget. See docs/PERFORMANCE_BUDGET.md#bundle-size-budget.
